title: Notification toast
description: A notification toast (bottom-right / bottom-left stack in the workbench): severity icon, message, toolbar (⚙ More Actions when configure, expand/collapse chevron, ✕ Clear) and, while expanded, a details row with "Source: …" and buttons (first primary). Mirrors NotificationsToasts + NotificationRenderer (notificationsViewer.ts): compact 34px modern-ui rows, wrapped messages grow the row by their extra lines, notifications with buttons are always expanded, slide/fade-in and severity-based auto-dismiss. Captured from VS Code Insiders (serve-web) toasts in Dark 2026 and Light 2026; the runtime list id is normalized to list_id_7 (unused by other lists in this system). Known verification drift: the error and warning references were not the last toast in their stack, where modern UI drops the bottom margin (`:not(:last-child)`), so the single-toast examples are 4px taller.
usage: Inside <vsc-notification-toasts> (a direct child of <vsc-workbench>). Prefer toasts.show({ severity, message, buttons, source }) from script; it returns the element. Listen for "action" (detail.label) and "close". Use buttons for actions like "Undo"; leave source empty for product (core) notifications. Not for blocking questions: use <vsc-dialog>.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Message text (plain; use the default slot for rich text such as links)

attributes.name: buttons
attributes.description: Comma-separated button labels; the first is primary. Notifications with buttons are always expanded and can't collapse (except compact, where they sit inline)

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Shown as "Source: …" in the details row while expanded (extensions set this; core notifications don't). Ignored when compact

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Expanded state for notifications without buttons (toggled by the chevron when there is a source)

attributes.name: configure
attributes.description: Show the ⚙ "More Actions..." dropdown (notifications with secondary actions, e.g. from extensions)

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Compact variant (design-tool addition, not in VS Code): a single row with buttons inline after the message, no toolbar (no ✕), auto-dismissed after 5s. For brief confirmations like "Marked as done. [Undo]"

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Auto-dismiss delay in ms (overrides the default: compact 5000; otherwise info 10000, warning 12000, error 15000)

attributes.name: sticky
attributes.description: Don't auto-dismiss (by default: info 10s, warning 12s, error 15s, compact 5s; paused while hovered or focused)

slots.description: Rich message content (used when no message attribute is set)

states.name: expanded
states.description: Details row with source and buttons; row grows

states.name: compact
states.description: Single 34px row, buttons inline after the message, no ✕, 5s auto-dismiss

states.name: fade-in
states.description: Slides up and fades in over 300ms

states.name: auto-dismiss
states.description: Removed after 10/12/15s (info/warning/error), 5s when compact, unless hovered, focused or sticky

variants.name: compact
variants.description: Single row with inline buttons, no close button, auto-dismissed after 5s. Not in VS Code; authored on top of the captured toast styles.

examples.title: Info with a button
examples.html: <vsc-notification-toasts static><vsc-notification severity="info" message="Marked as done." source="DT Notify" buttons="Undo" configure sticky no-animation></vsc-notification></vsc-notification-toasts>

examples.title: Error with source and two buttons
examples.html: <vsc-notification-toasts static><vsc-notification severity="error" message="Build failed on darwin-arm64: @vscode/spdlog has no prebuild for Electron 39." source="DT Notify" buttons="Open Session,Retry" configure sticky no-animation></vsc-notification></vsc-notification-toasts>

examples.title: Warning, collapsed
examples.html: <vsc-notification-toasts static><vsc-notification severity="warning" message="Session deleted." source="DT Notify" configure sticky no-animation></vsc-notification></vsc-notification-toasts>

examples.title: Core info (no source, no buttons)
examples.html: <vsc-notification-toasts static><vsc-notification severity="info" message="Session started. It'll land in Ready for you when it's done." sticky no-animation></vsc-notification></vsc-notification-toasts>

examples.title: Compact with Undo
examples.html: <vsc-notification-toasts static><vsc-notification compact severity="info" message="Marked as done." buttons="Undo" sticky no-animation></vsc-notification></vsc-notification-toasts>

examples.title: Compact, no button
examples.html: <vsc-notification-toasts static><vsc-notification compact severity="info" message="Sent to Copilot. It moved to Working." sticky no-animation></vsc-notification></vsc-notification-toasts>
